title: Procurement of Metal Halide Lamps & Lamp Holder for Various Lighthouses
summary: Notice inviting sealed quotations for supply of metal halide lamps (70 W and 150 W) and double-ended lamp holders for various lighthouses, issued by the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin

scope.item: 70 W metal halide lamp, single ended, day white, preferably Osram/Philips/Havells or equivalent
150 W metal halide lamp, single ended, day white, preferably Osram/Philips/Havells or equivalent
150 W metal halide lamp, double ended, day white, preferably Osram/Philips/Havells or equivalent
150 W double ended metal halide lamp holder

money.notes: No estimate or EMD printed. Rates FOR destination; GST to be shown separately, otherwise deemed inclusive. Payment within 15 days of supply.

period.completion: Supply within 15 days from date of supply order
period.bid_validity: 45 days from date of opening of quotations
period.warranty: As per OEM, to be specified for each item

specs: Metal halide lamps day white, single and double ended; OEM technical brochure and specification sheets required
notes: One-page NIQ with schedule (rates blank); lighthouses not named. Quotations due 22.09.2023 15:00, opened 16:00 same day. Similar later NIQ for the same file number is nid 1561.
